title: Master Study Timetable — 8hrs/day · 44 Skills
purpose: Scheduling layer over the same 44 skills: phase order, weeks, study days, hours, and a day-by-day plan with resource references.

cells.label: DAY 1
cells.detail: Variables, types, operators, input/output, f-strings. Install Python, VSCode, venv.

cells.label: DAY 2
cells.detail: if/elif/else, for loops, while loops, break/continue. Build 5 small programs.

cells.label: DAY 3
cells.detail: def, args, kwargs, return, default params, scope, recursion basics, lambda.

cells.label: DAY 4
cells.detail: Lists, tuples, dicts, sets — methods, comprehensions, slicing, nested structures.

cells.label: DAY 5
cells.detail: Classes, __init__, attributes, methods, self. Build a Bank Account class.

cells.label: SAT
cells.detail: Optional: review weak areas from Mon–Fri

cells.label: DAY 7
cells.detail: Inheritance, polymorphism, dunder methods, properties, class vs instance attrs.

cells.label: DAY 8
cells.detail: import, pip, venv, requirements.txt, __init__.py, building a package.

cells.label: DAY 9
cells.detail: open(), read/write, with statement, try/except/finally, custom exceptions.

cells.label: DAY 10
cells.detail: Generators, iterators, decorators, context managers, *args/**kwargs advanced.

cells.label: DAY 11
cells.detail: Arrays, vectorized ops (NumPy). Series, DataFrame, read_csv, basic manipulation (pandas).

cells.label: DAY 12
cells.detail: Build: CLI inventory manager with CSV persistence, OOP design, full error handling.

cells.label: DAY 13
cells.detail: pytest basics, assertions, fixtures. Write tests for your inventory manager project.

cells.label: DAY 14
cells.detail: Review all concepts. Refactor project. Solve 10 HackerRank Python challenges.

cells.label: SAT
cells.detail: Rest

cells.label: DAY 21

cells.label: DAY 22
cells.detail: Views, materialized views, stored procedures, triggers, JSON in PostgreSQL.

cells.label: DAY 23
